title: Slick Lights - Dynamic Lighting (Custom Torch Glow)
description: Torch glow, item illumination, and realistic flame flicker with zero server lag. Fully customize your glowing items and mobs using a simple in-game menu!
body:
# Slick Lights — High-Performance Dynamic Lighting

Slick Lights adds smooth, real-time dynamic lighting to your world without the lag. While older packs constantly scan hundreds of blocks and tank your server's TPS, this pack uses a highly optimized engine that tracks coordinates directly, placing and removing light blocks only when and where they are needed.

---

## Features

* **Handheld Items:** Torches, lanterns, campfires, and candles dynamically light your path. It also tracks steady light blocks like glowstone, sea lanterns, and froglights.
* **Luminous Mobs and Projectiles:** Blazes, Magma Cubes, flying Fireballs, Allays, and Glow Squids naturally illuminate their surroundings within a 32-block radius of players.
* **Glowing Status Effects:** Any player or mob hit with a spectral arrow instantly becomes a moving light source via the glowing effect.
* **Full Dimension Support:** Garbage collection routines ensure dynamic lighting works cleanly across the Overworld, the Nether, and the End.

---

## In-Game Actionbar Menu

Slick Lights features a completely seamless settings menu right on your actionbar—no clunky chest interfaces or chat spam required.

Run `/function slick_lights:settings` to toggle the menu:

* **Navigate:** Tap your **Sneak/Crouch** key to cycle through the different settings (Mob Tracking, Item Tracking, Tick Rate, Flicker, and Base Light).
* **Adjust:** Press **Hotbar keys 1–9** to instantly change the values or toggle states of the highlighted setting.
